    DoubleClick = true,
})

    Default = 'End',
    Mode = 'Toggle',
    Text = 'Menu keybind',
    NoUI = true,
})
Menu:AddToggle('hidewatermarktoggle', {
    Text = 'Enable Watermark',
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(Value) Library:SetWatermarkVisibility(Value) end,
})

-- Watermark
Library:SetWatermarkVisibility(true)
Library:SetWatermark(('Ank0 | %s | %s'):format(
        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name,
        os.date('%X')
    ))

Library:OnUnload(function()
    print('Unloaded!')
    Library.Unloaded = true
end)

-- Addons Setup
ThemeManager:SetLibrary(Library)
SaveManager:SetLibrary(Library)
SaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ 'MenuKeybind' })

-- Allows you to have a custom keybind for opening/closing the menu
Library.ToggleKeybind = Options.MenuKeybind

ThemeManager:SetFolder('MyUILibrary')
SaveManager:SetFolder('MyUILibrary/specific-game')
SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(Tabs['UI Settings'])
ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(Tabs['UI Settings'])
SaveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()

-- Re-apply the custom theme through the actual color pickers (not just Library.XxxColor).
-- ThemeManager:ApplyToTab() resets the theme dropdown to 'Default' on load, which
-- overwrites the color pickers' saved values too — reassigning Library.XxxColor alone
-- isn't enough, since any later ThemeUpdate() call pulls colors back from these Options.
Options.BackgroundColor:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26))
Options.MainColor:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28))
Options.AccentColor:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 64))
Options.OutlineColor:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50))
Options.FontColor:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(148, 148, 148))
Library.Font = Enum.Font.Code
ThemeManager:ThemeUpdate()
